title: Classroom Assignment: Replication Package
description: Institutional scheduling data from eight consecutive academic periods, MiniZinc instances derived from it, the timetabling and room-assignment models, and the scripts that reproduce every table and figure in the accompanying article. Teachers carry labels local to this extract; the source system's own identifiers and the row-level surrogate keys are not released, because the system's public endpoint returns them next to the teacher's name. The extract is pseudonymised rather than anonymous: a schedule can be matched against the institution's public schedule page, which the README explains in full. No student-level data is included, and no personal datum has been estimated or inferred.
